verdict.rationale: AFK integrates with specific business tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) but there is no evidence of MCP server support or a plugin mechanism for arbitrary MCP tools; probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs both 404. [2026-09-24 adversarial bias audit: reverted na q0 -> none q0. Six competitors in this arena without MCP client support (zapier, make, pipedream, temporal, trigger-dev, windmill) are graded none, so the axis is applicable to workflow platforms; na would remove it from AFK's score denominator and favor the owner product. The newly cited afk-docs-16 is generic marketing copy and says nothing about MCP. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
